title: 8 Best Serverless Security Solutions for Every Business Size (2026)
content_md: Quick Answer: The standalone serverless-security market no longer exists it merged into CNAPPs. Prisma Cloud (which absorbed pioneer PureSec) leads function protection; Aqua , Sysdig , Datadog , and Check Point CloudGuard cover functions within broader platforms. Honesty note: several once-listed vendors ( Vandium , Dashbird , standalone PureSec ) are defunct or absorbed we say so below. Serverless was supposed to make security someone else’s problem; instead it relocated the problem to what the provider can’t see: over-privileged function roles, vulnerable dependencies, event-injection attacks, and business logic executing in 200-millisecond bursts no agent can watch. Managing these risks requires evaluating broader cloud security platforms alongside securing execution flows against severe threats, like when hackers exploit Google Cloud services via manipulated serverless deployment functions. The market answered with a wave of startups and then absorbed nearly all of them into CNAPPs, because functions are one workload type among many, not a separate program. This brief reviews the eight names on legacy shortlists with unusual honesty: who leads, who serves their platform, and who no longer exists because E-E-A-T means telling you when a category died. How we evaluate: independent editorial analysis; no paid placement. Pricing by model only. Table of Contents 1. Decision Matrix 2. The 8 Names in Depth (Including the Honest Obituaries) 3. Full Comparison Table 4. Buyer’s Gui
